summary: Complaints centre on the Aligarh-Moradabad highway land route, poor village roads, too few doctors at the Asmoli CHC, sugarcane prices and weak government school education, while residents mainly appreciate law and order and electricity.

positives.english: Law and order has improved compared to earlier
positives.hindi: कानून व्यवस्था पहले से बेहतर है
positives.basis: Amar Ujala Asmoli constituency report (4 Sep 2026): several residents said law and order has improved; Nasir Hussain and Jamshed Ansari praised it

positives.english: Electricity supply has improved since the current government came to power
positives.hindi: बिजली पहले से ठीक मिलने लगी है
positives.basis: Amar Ujala Asmoli constituency report (4 Sep 2026): one resident (Nasir) said electricity has improved since the BJP came to power; only one resident raised it

positives.english: Construction has started on the Khempur-Bhainsora road in Asmoli block
positives.hindi: खेमपुर-भैंसोड़ा सड़क बनने का काम शुरू हुआ है
positives.basis: India Daily (page updated 23 Jun 2026): 2.5 km road costing Rs 153.55 lakh, funded from MLC funds, work launched, ~30 villages, expected in six months, status ongoing and not finished; villagers said the route was nearly impassable in rain; Asmoli block named, Asmoli AC membership unconfirmed

positives.english: Government work is going well, says a local resident
positives.hindi: सरकार का काम ठीक चल रहा है
positives.basis: Amar Ujala Asmoli constituency report (4 Sep 2026): Shakil Ahmed said the government is working well and all work is being done properly; Anil Kumar Sharma said governance is good

positives.english: Inference: a programme to inaugurate many development projects in Sambhal district was announced
positives.hindi: *संभल में कई विकास कार्यों के लोकार्पण की योजना है
positives.basis: Inference: Patrika (6 Aug 2025) reported a planned programme of 221 works in Sambhal district (108 foundation stones, 113 inaugurations, Rs 546.25 crore); a planned programme, not confirmed delivered, district-level, does not name Asmoli

negatives.english: Fear of losing homes and schools in 14 villages due to the Aligarh-Moradabad highway route
negatives.hindi: अलीगढ़-मुरादाबाद हाईवे से 14 गांवों के घर और स्कूल उजड़ने का डर
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (9 Oct 2026): MLA Pinki Yadav and MP Dharmendra Yadav met Gadkari; the article names 14 villages of Asmoli assembly constituency (and 10 of Gunnaur) where homes, businesses and schools face displacement; they asked for a route change and market-value land purchase instead of circle rates

negatives.english: Asmoli CHC has too few doctors; patients have to go elsewhere for treatment
negatives.hindi: असमोली सीएचसी में डॉक्टर कम हैं, बाहर जाना पड़ता है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (19 Aug 2026): Asmoli CHC has 3 MBBS doctors and no specialists against 8 needed (6 specialists); serves 100+ villages; patients pay private hospitals or are referred to district hospital; no eye surgeon or delivery surgeon. Article names Asmoli CHC and Sambhal, not the constituency; AC membership unconfirmed (CHC is in Asmoli town, the AC's namesake)

negatives.english: Village roads are in very poor condition
negatives.hindi: गांव की सड़कें बहुत खराब हैं
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala Asmoli constituency report (4 Sep 2026): Hussain and Yakub said village roads are in poor condition; Yakub called roads the biggest issue; Pawan Kumar said roads need to be built; no village named

negatives.english: Sugar prices went up but sugarcane price did not rise
negatives.hindi: चीनी के दाम बढ़े पर गन्ने का दाम नहीं बढ़ा
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala Asmoli constituency report (4 Sep 2026): Anil Kumar Sharma said sugar prices have risen but cane prices have not; farmers' statement; no mill or dues figure given

negatives.english: No concrete steps taken on education in our area; government school education is weak
negatives.hindi: हमारे इलाके में शिक्षा पर कोई ठोस कदम नहीं उठे
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala Asmoli constituency report (4 Sep 2026): Deepak said no concrete steps have been taken on education locally; Sumit Rawat urged parents to use government schools

round2.changes: Verified all cited URLs by fetching: Sep 4 and Oct 9 Amar Ujala articles, Patrika 6 Aug 2025, Wikipedia AC list (no 32 Asmoli, None, Sambhal confirmed). Oct 9 URL switched from amarujala.com to www.amarujala.com (opens). Removed Saindhari negative (Oct 7 article: no road, but places it in Asmoli block, AC membership unconfirmed) and Saindhari order positive (order only). Replaced with Asmoli CHC doctor shortage negative (Amar Ujala 19 Aug 2026, new) and Khempur-Bhainsora road under construction positive (India Daily, started project, new). Positive 5 stays a flagged inference. Corrected Shakeel to Shakil Ahmed. Re-ranked positives and negatives. Searches for Asmoli sugarcane mill dues, substation and village drains returned nothing Asmoli-specific.

notes: AC identity confirmed: No. 32 Asmoli, reserved None, district Sambhal (Wikipedia list page). Wikipedia Asmoli AC page gives no extent (tehsils/blocks/villages), so AC membership of Asmoli block villages (Saindhari, Madala, Khempur, Bhainsora) is unconfirmed. Negatives 1, 3, 4, 5 are AC-level (Amar Ujala reports naming the Asmoli constituency; 1 names 14 villages inside it). ac_specific_negatives = 4 counts those; the strict named-place count is 1 (the highway item) plus the CHC item if its AC membership is accepted. Positive 2 (electricity) rests on one resident. Positive 3 is a started project, not completed, AC membership unconfirmed (Asmoli block). Positive 5 is a flagged inference from a 2025 district-level plan with no delivery evidence for Asmoli. Sugarcane: no Asmoli-specific mill dues report found; Bilari and Bareilly reports are other districts. Saindhari Arogya Mandir had no access road per 7 Oct 2026 Amar Ujala, but its AC membership is unconfirmed, so it is not used. Hepatitis/groundwater claim (2024) found only as a secondary summary, not opened, not used. Sot river revival at Matipur (2019, still ongoing, constituency not stated) not used. Field checks: highway route and land compensation at circle rates; Saindhari road; Khempur-Bhainsora road completion; Asmoli CHC staffing; sugarcane dues from the nearest mill; whether Saindhari/Madala/Khempur are inside the AC.
